item.text: The page is complete, and the text and button colors pass contrast checks. Browser preview is blocked by the environment, so I’m checking the HTML and phone link directly.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
class Check(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.links=[]; self.dates=[]; self.headings=0
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs=dict(attrs)
        if tag=='a': self.links.append(attrs.get('href'))
        if tag=='time': self.dates.append(attrs.get('datetime'))
        if tag=='h1': self.headings+=1
p=Check(); source=Path('index.html').read_text(); p.feed(source)
assert p.links==['tel:+15035550142']
assert p.dates==['2027-07-01','2027-07-21','2027-07-22']
assert p.headings==1
assert not any(line.rstrip()"'!=line for line in source.splitlines())
assert '"'<script' not in source and '<link' not in source
print('HTML checks passed: closure and reopening dates, phone link, one main heading, and no external dependencies.')
PY"
